dct_description_sm: At head of title: Shiloh National Military Park.

At head of title: Shiloh National Military Park. Includes fortifications, roads, railroads, rivers, towns, and the names of few residents. Some roads have been hand-colored. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:82,000. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 439 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
